```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
infile  <- "/projectnb/ds596/projects/Team 9/scQC_project/colon_immune_raw.rds"
out_dir <- "/projectnb/ds596/projects/Team 9/scQC_project/extension/ddqc_resolution_params"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

seurat_obj <- readRDS(infile)

cat("Loaded object with", nrow(seurat_obj), "genes and", ncol(seurat_obj), "cells\n")
```

## Compute QC Metrics

```{r}
if (!"percent.mt" %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)) {
  seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^MT-")
}

ribo_genes <- grep("^RP[SL]", rownames(seurat_obj), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
seurat_obj[["percent.ribo"]] <- if (length(ribo_genes) > 0) {
  PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, features = ribo_genes)
} else {
  0
}
```

## Basic Filtering

```{r}
seu_prefilt <- subset(
  seurat_obj,
  subset = nFeature_RNA >= 100 & percent.mt <= 80
)

cat("Cells after basic filtering:", ncol(seu_prefilt), "\n")
```

## Resolution experiment

```{r}
resolutions <- c(0.4, 0.8, 1.3, 1.6, 2.0)

npcs_use <- 50
k_param <- 20
random_seed <- 29
ddqc_threshold <- 2.0

results_list <- list()
```


## Loop over Resolutions

```{r}
for (res in resolutions) {
  
  cat("\nRunning resolution:", res, "\n")
  
  seu_cluster <- seu_prefilt
  
  # Preprocessing
  seu_cluster <- NormalizeData(seu_cluster, verbose = FALSE)
  seu_cluster <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_cluster, verbose = FALSE)
  seu_cluster <- ScaleData(seu_cluster, verbose = FALSE)
  seu_cluster <- RunPCA(seu_cluster, npcs = npcs_use, verbose = FALSE)
  
  seu_cluster <- FindNeighbors(
    seu_cluster,
    dims = 1:npcs_use,
    k.param = k_param,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Clustering with variable resolution
  seu_cluster <- FindClusters(
    seu_cluster,
    resolution = res,
    random.seed = random_seed,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  seu_cluster <- RunUMAP(seu_cluster, dims = 1:npcs_use, verbose = FALSE)
  
  n_clusters <- length(unique(seu_cluster$seurat_clusters))
  cat("Clusters:", n_clusters, "\n")
  
  ## Save pre-ddqc UMAP
  p_pre <- DimPlot(seu_cluster, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
    ggtitle(paste("Pre-ddqc UMAP (res =", res, ")"))
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("UMAP_pre_ddqc_res_", res, ".png")),
    p_pre, width = 7, height = 6
  )
  

  
  meta <- seu_cluster@meta.data %>%
    rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = as.character(seurat_clusters),
      n_counts = nCount_RNA,
      n_genes = nFeature_RNA,
      percent_mito = percent.mt,
      percent_ribo = percent.ribo
    )
  
  cutoffs <- meta %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      counts_median = median(n_counts),
      counts_mad = mad(n_counts, constant = 1.4826),
      genes_median = median(n_genes),
      genes_mad = mad(n_genes, constant = 1.4826),
      mito_median = median(percent_mito),
      mito_mad = mad(percent_mito, constant = 1.4826),
      ribo_median = median(percent_ribo),
      ribo_mad = mad(percent_ribo, constant = 1.4826),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_counts_lower = pmax(0, counts_median - ddqc_threshold * counts_mad),
      n_counts_upper = counts_median + ddqc_threshold * counts_mad,
      n_genes_lower = genes_median - ddqc_threshold * genes_mad,
      n_genes_upper = genes_median + ddqc_threshold * genes_mad,
      percent_mito_upper = mito_median + ddqc_threshold * mito_mad,
      percent_ribo_upper = ribo_median + ddqc_threshold * ribo_mad
    )
  
  meta_labeled <- meta %>%
    left_join(cutoffs, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      keep =
        n_counts >= n_counts_lower &
        n_counts <= n_counts_upper &
        n_genes >= n_genes_lower &
        n_genes <= n_genes_upper &
        percent_mito <= percent_mito_upper &
        percent_ribo <= percent_ribo_upper
    )
  
  cells_keep <- meta_labeled %>% filter(keep) %>% pull(cell)
  
  seu_ddqc <- subset(seu_prefilt, cells = cells_keep)
  
  ## Post-ddqc processing
  seu_ddqc <- NormalizeData(seu_ddqc)
  seu_ddqc <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_ddqc)
  seu_ddqc <- ScaleData(seu_ddqc)
  seu_ddqc <- RunPCA(seu_ddqc, npcs = npcs_use)
  seu_ddqc <- FindNeighbors(seu_ddqc, dims = 1:npcs_use)
  seu_ddqc <- FindClusters(seu_ddqc, resolution = res)
  seu_ddqc <- RunUMAP(seu_ddqc, dims = 1:npcs_use)
  
  
  p_post <- DimPlot(seu_ddqc, reduction = "umap") +
    ggtitle(paste("Post-ddqc UMAP (res =", res, ")"))
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("UMAP_post_ddqc_res_", res, ".png")),
    p_post, width = 7, height = 6
  )
  
  
  results_list[[as.character(res)]] <- data.frame(
    resolution = res,
    clusters = n_clusters,
    cells_before = ncol(seu_prefilt),
    cells_after = ncol(seu_ddqc),
    removed = ncol(seu_prefilt) - ncol(seu_ddqc),
    frac_removed = (ncol(seu_prefilt) - ncol(seu_ddqc)) / ncol(seu_prefilt)
  )
}
```


## Summary of Results

```{r}
results_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
results_df

write.csv(
  results_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "ddqc_resolution_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
